book_marginal_dIR_vs_R05.basis: net active IR vs KOSPI200 TR (contemporaneous realized-month), NW lag-3, n=268. R05 leg frozen ret_net. Book = Return.portfolio(0.85 R05 + 0.15 sleeve), monthly rebal.
book_marginal_dIR_vs_R05.honest_caveat: dIR +0.0593 > 0.05 (authoritative, ABOVE the marginal threshold; optimizer design EW estimate was +0.049 below). BUT risk RX-2 (cov_contribution 95%CI [-0.0149,+0.0056] straddles 0; downside cov flips +0.0014) means the in-sample positive dIR is statistically UNCERTAIN. Combined with standalone alpha FAIL (port-a t 1.46) and active-SR OOS collapse (oos_retention 0.171), this is a LOW-CONVICTION marginal admit, not a confident one.

gate_assessment._note: measurement-graduation §3 severity applied to forge-authoritative book values.

oos_retention_0.7.honest: Active-vs-BM SR retention 0.171 << 0.7 -> HARD FAIL on the active-Sharpe definition. CRITICAL: this is INHERITED from R05 itself (R05 active-SR retention 0.166), NOT introduced by the sleeve. Driver = KOSPI200 rallied 2024-26 (BM cum +grey curve), compressing realized active alpha OOS; the BOOK total-SR retention is healthy 0.884 (IS 1.614 -> OOS 1.428). Honest flag for judge: the active-alpha-vs-BM hurdle is failed by the incumbent book on this panel split, so it is not a discriminating gate for THIS sleeve's incremental value.

gate_assessment.honest_overall: Book PASSES PORT_t (4.90 >> 2.95), Calmar (1.01 > 0.64), DSR (1.0), net_IR (0.78). FAILS active-SR oos_retention (0.171 < 0.7) — but the failure is a property of the frozen incumbent R05 active-alpha decay vs a rallying KOSPI200, not of the residual-mom sleeve (book total-SR retention 0.884 is strong). The sleeve's OWN value-add is the marginal dIR +0.0593 (statistically uncertain per risk RX-2).

vs_optimizer_design_stage.reconciliation: Book SR matches within 0.018pp (NEGLIGIBLE). dIR slightly higher in forge (+0.059 vs +0.049) and R05 IR higher (0.725 vs 0.661) because forge uses CONTEMPORANEOUS realized-month KOSPI200 alignment, while optimizer finalize.R used a one-month-FORWARD-shifted BM (shift(bm_ret,lead)) joined to R05's realized return — a benchmark misalignment (same family as risk RF-R6). Forge alignment (R05 ret_net month Y vs KOSPI200 realized month Y) is PIT-correct; R05 beta consequently 0.108 (vs opt -0.054) and book beta 0.244 (vs opt 0.107). Economic conclusion UNCHANGED: marginal diversifier, no SR-2.5 lever.

handoff_to_judge.ready_qualifier: Authoritative bt_result built + audited (integrity WARNING, 0 FAIL). Gate values supplied for Judge Gate C (PORT_t 4.90 >= 2.95 PASS, net_IR 0.78 > 0.2 PASS). HONEST: marginal-admit diversifier with active-SR OOS-retention HARD-fail (inherited from R05), statistically-uncertain dIR (risk RX-2), standalone alpha FAIL (alpha t 1.46). NOT an SR-2.5 solution.
judge_focus: Gate C: PORT_t 4.90 (book) PASS; but is the dIR +0.059 a real incremental edge given risk RX-2 CI straddles 0?
oos_retention active-SR 0.171 HARD-fail — is it disqualifying, given it is inherited from the frozen incumbent R05 (0.166) and book total-SR retention is 0.884?
DPL transition recommendation (optimizer + measurement-graduation §5) — sleeve+overlay has structural SR ceiling ~1.70.

honest_conclusion: Authoritative book (0.85 R05 + 0.15 residual-mom EW, overlay OFF): net Sharpe 1.683, CAGR 35.4%, MDD 35.1%, Calmar 1.01, PORT_t 4.90, book-marginal dIR vs R05 +0.0593 (> 0.05 threshold). This CONFIRMS the optimizer design-stage (book SR ~1.70, dIR ~0.05-0.06) within rounding. The residual-mom sleeve IS a marginally-admissible diversifier (dIR clears 0.05) but: (1) the dIR is statistically uncertain (risk RX-2 95%CI straddles 0); (2) standalone alpha FAILED graduation (port-a t 1.46 < 2.95); (3) active-vs-BM oos_retention 0.171 HARD-fails (inherited from R05, not the sleeve). The SR-2.5 target is NOT reached (book 1.68 vs 2.5). Overlay ON gives MDD control (35%->22%) but NO SR lift and HURTS active IR (-0.157). Recommendation aligns with optimizer: marginal diversifier admit is LOW-CONVICTION; the real lever is DPL (measurement-graduation §5), not more sleeve/overlay stacking.
